notes.title: WFH ↔ VASUP In-House Office Integration Guide
notes.content:
# WFH (Home PC) ↔ VASUP In-House Office Hub

This workspace bridges your **Work From Home (WFH)** setup with the **VASUP In-House Office** environment.

### Daily WFH Workflow:
1. **VPN & Access**: Launch your In-House VPN or Remote Gateway from the Quick Portals tab.
2. **Cross-Device Drops**: Transfer meeting links, credentials, tokens, or scripts between your Home PC and In-House Notebook.
3. **CRUD Controls**: Save, Edit, Download as Markdown/Text, and Delete any document or task.
4. **In-House Standup**: Log daily tasks and export standup summaries for the office team.

> *Pro Tip*: Use `Ctrl+K` anywhere to search notes, tasks, or trigger quick actions!

notes.title: In-House Office Network & VPN Configuration
notes.content:
## In-House Office Network Config

- **Office Gateway**: `vpn.vasup.office`
- **Intranet Domain**: `vasup.franktest.xyz` / `vasup.franktest.com`
- **Remote Desktop / SSH Port**: `3389` / `22`
- **In-House File Share**: Accessible via the Sync Hub Drop Zone.

### Environment Sync Checklist:
- [x] WFH Home PC Connected
- [ ] In-House Corporate Notebook Connected
- [ ] Daily Standup Updated
